Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP: evaluation timeline & next steps — infra update

Hi all — quick infra/bench update ahead of Thursday.

Status: we have a draft perf plan and a lightweight test harness ready; it covers latency P95/P99, throughput with batching, and memory consumption across 1k/5k/10k token sequences.

Open items / asks from ACME:
- Provide a representative sample of the 3 E2E scenarios we discussed (expected token lengths + typical prompt patterns) — aim to get these by 6/17
- Confirm whether we can run tests against a masked production snapshot or need synthetic dataset (privacy)

Planned deliverables:
- Perf plan & CI config uploaded to the shared Drive folder by 6/22
- Initial run results (synthetic) by 6/25; runs against masked snapshot after dataset received

Quick decision note: we recommend starting with synthetic runs (faster) and then running one masked snapshot check before the final close. If Acme prefers to run everything on masked snapshot, we will need access details and a slightly extended timeline.

On Thu we'll propose the perf test cadence and confirm owners for test execution (Ben for Redwood infra lead; Stephanie will help with scenario mapping).

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Maria and team — thank you for today's 30m checkpoint. Below is a concise recap of decisions, owners, due dates, and the agenda for next week's sync (6/25).

Decisions made (6/18):
- Weekly 30m MAP checkpoints confirmed (Thursdays 11:00am PT)
- Start with synthetic perf runs; one masked snapshot run before final close
- Security questionnaire owner confirmed: Rishi will own responses and coordinate evidence upload

Owners & deliverables: 
- Rishi Malhotra — complete security questionnaire & upload evidence to shared Drive (due 2026-06-19)
- Ben Carter — upload perf plan & CI config to Drive (due 2026-06-22)
- Stephanie Nguyen — deliver data handling checklist and sample log extraction instructions (due 2026-06-25)
- Jasmine Liu — draft SOW & pricing; share for internal review (due 2026-06-29)

Attachments: acme_map_v2.xlsx (owners & timeline updated), security_q_2026.pdf (marked with notes)

Next-week agenda (6/25):
1) Review perf plan & initial synthetic runs (Ben)
2) Walkthrough of security questionnaire status & required evidence (Rishi)
3) Data handling checklist & sample extraction approach (Stephanie)
4) Commercial term open items (Jasmine)

Action items for ACME: please upload the three representative E2E scenarios or confirm that Redwood should proceed with the synthetic dataset (requested by 2026-06-17; still outstanding). If you prefer masked snapshot testing only, let us know ASAP — that will push the close target by ~1 week.

If anything above needs correction, please flag in-line. Otherwise we'll treat this as the working MAP for next week and circulate updated MAP file (owners tab) after the meeting.
